title: Exact K ingress buffering and write-width physical comparison
hypothesis: The automatic-target ping-pong 256-bit transposer can reduce K-head service from 12,351 to 4,160 cycles at an acceptable control and 2 KiB extra transpose-storage cost.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Does the 2.97x functional K-ingress speedup remain Pareto-useful after routed area, timing, and vectorless power are measured?
include: all-bit LFSR activity and checksum folding
Nangate45 routed critical path, standard-cell area, and vectorless power
exclude: 128 KiB 64-bank K-stage macro area and access energy

required_evaluations.objective: Measure p53/p54 one-buffer and ping-pong exact K ingress transpose PPA across a broad Nangate45 timing sweep.

remaining_abstractions: The narrow-I/O LFSR/checksum harness overhead is included in each measured row.
The 128 KiB K-stage and 1 KiB Q-stage arrays require separate characterized SRAM composition.
Vectorless power is a screening metric until exact Llama7B activity is applied.
Capacity/HBM gather, shared mesh, and external HBM controller/PHY remain outside this comparison.
